title: Remove Vestigial Spernakit Config Drift
description: Remove vestigial spernakit-era configuration that carried over into the bare vite-react scaffold: two orphaned eslint.config.js files, the empty frontend/ directory, and (if prettier is not adopted) the orphaned .prettierrc. These reference backend/, scripts/, drizzle, tailwind, and components/ui that do not exist here and cannot run.
notes: Removed the two orphaned spernakit-era eslint.config.js files (root + frontend/) — both imported uninstalled packages (@eslint/js, typescript-eslint, eslint-plugin-perfectionist, eslint-plugin-react-hooks, etc.) and referenced nonexistent backend/**, scripts/**, drizzle.config.ts, tailwind.config.js paths; linting in this repo runs via oxlint (.oxlintrc.json), so these configs were dead and unrunnable. Deleted the now-empty frontend/ directory (it contained only the removed eslint config). Kept .prettierrc: it is backed by installed prettier@3.9.4 + prettier-plugin-organize-attributes + prettier-plugin-sort-json (adopted in remediation-quality-gate-scripts) and no longer references prettier-plugin-tailwindcss, so it is live, not orphaned. bun run smoke:qc (typecheck + oxlint + tsc -b && vite build + format:check) passes clean after cleanup.
spec:
1. Verify the root eslint.config.js is removed OR replaced with a config whose plugins are actually installed and whose file globs match this repo (no backend/**, scripts/**, drizzle.config.ts references)
2. Verify frontend/eslint.config.js is removed and, if frontend/ then contains no other files, the empty frontend/ directory is removed
3. Verify .prettierrc is either backed by installed prettier + plugins (see remediation-quality-gate-scripts) or removed — no config referencing prettier-plugin-tailwindcss while tailwind/prettier are uninstalled
4. Verify linting still runs via `bun run lint` (oxlint) with no errors after cleanup
5. Verify `bun run build` still passes after cleanup
6. Rationale: dead configuration referencing a spernakit stack that this client-only Vite SPA does not have will mislead contributors and cannot execute; the repo should match its actual bare-Vite shape
